title: Figgle
description: Generate ASCII art logos and stylized text from strings in .NET.

data.text: `Figgle` is a small library that converts plain text into large ASCII art banners. It includes many built-in fonts and is useful for CLI apps, README badges, and console output.
Use the static `Figgle` class and pick a font to generate an ASCII art version of any string.

data.title: Basic Figgle Usage
data.content: Generate ASCII art with a chosen font.

data.text: Figgle includes many fonts such as `Standard`, `Big`, `Small`, `Slant`, and `Graceful`. Use the one that fits your CLI style.

data.title: Switching Fonts
data.content: Render the same text with different Figgle fonts.

terms.definition: A static class containing predefined font styles.
Converts a string into ASCII art using the selected font.

data.title: Tip
data.text: ASCII art can vary in width. If you embed Figgle output in a console, verify the terminal font is monospaced.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Figgle converts text into ASCII art banners
Useful for CLI apps and console output
data.takeaway: Figgle is a fun, lightweight way to add visual personality to command-line applications.
